observes: No-IRIS: IVGClient(max_retries=3, timeout=0.5) against a local counting stub of POST /api/cypher. A CREATE was executed 3x on persistent 500, 2x when the first attempt 'committed' then got a 502 (caller saw success, no sign of the duplicate), and 3x when each attempt 'committed' but answered after the read timeout (caller got IVGClientError). Reads and writes treated identically. Oracle = working assumption (no resend of a non-idempotent write after an ambiguous outcome); the retry itself is the documented behaviour (sdk.py docstrings, API_REFERENCE, commit aaa54a44), so expected-violation, not fail.
